newsitem.title: FRANCE: AFP starts Internet financial information service.
newsitem.headline: AFP starts Internet financial information service.

text.p: French news agency Agence France Presse (AFP), broker Maison Roussin and computer company Skyworld launched on Thursday an Internet service to provide real-time financial information.
The service, called Mine and Yours, will initially allow online access to Maison Roussin's financial information and services and AFP's financial news, the group said in a statement.

Jean-Claude Carles, director of Skyworld and the new company, said it had set a target for turnover in its first year of 10 to 12 million francs and hoped to become a world leader in Internet financial services within three to four years.
The group is also in talks with the French stock exchange, French futures and options exchange MATIF and other financial information providers and hopes to launch additional products in September.
